prompt:
Clean up this UI copy. Tell me what's wrong with each piece and give me a direct replacement:

1. Button: 'Click here to proceed to the next step of the checkout process'
2. Error: 'There seems to have been an issue processing your payment at this time. Please try again later or contact support if the problem persists.'
3. Success: 'Your account has been successfully created and you can now begin using all of our features.'
4. Tooltip: 'This is where you can leverage our comprehensive suite of powerful reporting tools to gain in-depth insights into your data.'
assertions: The button replacement is 3 words or fewer. 'Continue', 'Next', 'Proceed' or similar — NOT 'Click here to proceed' or any phrase longer than 3 words.
The error replacement does NOT contain the words 'seems', 'appears', 'may have', 'at this time', or 'if the problem persists'. It states the condition directly in 10 words or fewer.
The success replacement does NOT contain the word 'successfully'. The replacement is 5 words or fewer (e.g., 'Account created', 'You're in', 'Done').
The tooltip replacement does NOT contain the words 'leverage', 'comprehensive', or 'powerful'. The replacement is 12 words or fewer and names what the section actually does.
